title: SyncSettings
description: Synced preferences. syncMessageContent is OFF by default; while it is off no message text leaves the device (Firestore rules enforce this for the content collection).

syncMessageContent.title: Sync message content
syncMessageContent.description: Opt-in. When true, message bodies and model-written reasons are synced to the private content collection.

updatedAt.title: Last changed
updatedAt.description: Epoch millis of the last change. Last writer wins.

deviceId.title: Device
deviceId.description: Stable random id of the device that wrote this document.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: Tombstone: the item was removed. Documents are kept so every device learns about the delete.
